title: Person
description: The unique individual human being who is a subject of record within a social protection system. Person is the persistent, indivisible unit of identity in registries; operational statuses such as Registrant, Applicant, or Beneficiary are transient roles defined by the person’s relationship to a specific Program, not properties of the person themselves.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Identifiers carried by this entity, such as national ID numbers, program IDs, or identifiers asserted by an identity document.

identity_documents.title: Identity documents
identity_documents.description: Identity documents held by this party, such as passports, national identity cards, civil registration certificates, and program-issued beneficiary cards.

name.title: Name
name.description: The full display name of the record. Depending on the concept, this is a person's or group's name, or the title of a program, instrument, scoring rule, or software product.

biometric_samples.title: Biometric samples
biometric_samples.description: Biometric samples associated with this person, linking to fingerprint, iris, face, and other biometric records.

country_of_birth.title: Country of birth
country_of_birth.description: The country where the person was born, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 code.

date_of_birth.title: Date of birth
date_of_birth.description: The date on which the person was born.

date_of_death.title: Date of death
date_of_death.description: The date on which the person died.

displacement_status.title: Displacement status
displacement_status.description: The legal, administrative, or protection status of the person with respect to displacement and migration.

domicile.title: Domicile
domicile.description: The place that the person treats as their permanent home, which may differ from the address of their current household.

education_level.title: Education level
education_level.description: The highest level of formal education completed by a person.

email_address.title: Email address
email_address.description: An email address through which the person can be contacted.

employment_status.title: Employment status
employment_status.description: The labour force participation status of the person: whether they are employed, unemployed, or outside the labour force.

ethnic_group.title: Ethnic group
ethnic_group.description: The ethnic or cultural group of the person, as self-identified. The UNSD recommends nationally defined categories based on self-identification; no international classification exists.

family_name.title: Family name
family_name.description: The family (last) name or surname of the person.

family_name_at_birth.title: Family name at birth
family_name_at_birth.description: The family name of the person at the time of birth, before any change due to marriage or other legal event.

functioning_status.title: Functioning status
functioning_status.description: A coarse current-state summary of the person's functioning difficulty, used by operational systems for targeting and eligibility queries. This is NOT a Washington Group or Child Functioning Module classification of the person: WG and CFM items are measured at the point of administration through a FunctioningProfile, and deriving a disability identifier requires applying a documented cutoff rule. Populate functioning_status from a FunctioningProfile only by citing the cutoff rule alongside; otherwise treat it as a self-declared or enumerator-judged summary.

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: The gender of the person as recorded in a social protection registry or identity document.

given_name.title: Given name
given_name.description: The given (first) name of the person.

given_name_at_birth.title: Given name at birth
given_name_at_birth.description: The given name of the person at the time of birth, before any legal name change.

group_memberships.title: Group memberships
group_memberships.description: Group memberships held by this person, linking them to households, families, or other groups.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: The branch of economic activity in which the person works, classified according to the International Standard Industrial Classification (ISIC Rev.4). Too large to enumerate; countries use national adaptations.

literacy.title: Literacy
literacy.description: Whether the person can, with understanding, both read and write a short simple statement on everyday life.

marital_status.title: Marital status
marital_status.description: The marital or civil status of a person as recorded in an administrative system.

matronymic_name.title: Matronymic name
matronymic_name.description: A name derived from the given name of the person's mother.

nationality.title: Nationality
nationality.description: The country of citizenship or nationality, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code where possible.

number_of_spouses.title: Number of spouses
number_of_spouses.description: The number of current spouses the person has. Captures polygamous or polyandrous union type separately from marital status, following the UN census framework and DHS approach.

nutrition_status.title: Nutrition status
nutrition_status.description: A coarse current-state summary of the person's acute malnutrition status, used by operational systems for targeting and referral queries. This is NOT a z-score classification on a specific measurement: band classifications depend on a growth reference, an age at measurement, and oedema status captured on a dedicated anthropometric profile published in a sibling schema (see ADR-011). Populate nutrition_status from an anthropometric profile only by citing the cutoff rule alongside.

occupation.title: Occupation
occupation.description: The person's primary occupation, classified according to the ISCO-08 sub-major groups.

patronymic_name.title: Patronymic name
patronymic_name.description: A name derived from the given name of the person's father or a paternal ancestor, used in naming conventions where patronymics are a distinct component of a person's full name.

phone_number.title: Phone number
phone_number.description: A contact phone number for the person, including country code.

preferred_language.title: Preferred language
preferred_language.description: The preferred language of communication for a person, using ISO 639-3 codes.

preferred_name.title: Preferred name
preferred_name.description: The name a person is commonly known by, when it differs from their legal name. Covers chosen names, professional names, and naming conventions where given name plus family name is insufficient.

pregnancy_status.title: Pregnancy status
pregnancy_status.description: The current pregnancy status of the person.

religion.title: Religion
religion.description: The religion, religious denomination, or sect of the person, as self-identified. No international classification exists; countries define their own value sets.

sex.title: Sex
sex.description: The biological sex of a person as recorded in an official register or identity document.

status_in_employment.title: Status in employment
status_in_employment.description: The type of employment relationship: whether the person is an employee, employer, own-account worker, contributing family worker, or cooperative member.
